panels.head: Sat Nov 21 — thaw
panels.text: A 16–20 lb turkey needs 4–5 days in the fridge. Put it in now, on a tray.

panels.head: Wed Nov 25 — test
panels.text: Check the thermometer in ice water. It should read 32°F.

panels.head: Thu Nov 26 — probe
panels.text: Thigh, wing and breast, 165°F. Pop-up timers pop late.

panels.head: Fri Nov 27 — leftovers
panels.text: Out of the fridge within two hours at dinner, eaten or frozen by Sunday.
